How to use it:

1. In Brave, open a YouTube video → Share → AutoVideo.
2. On the car screen, open AutoVideo.

If you share while the app is already open in the car, the video starts right away.

Requirement: in Android Auto → Developer settings, turn on “Unknown sources”.
Only use it while parked.
